dog.description_text:
Éclair is a gorgeous black kitten with a whole lot of personality packed into one tiny package. She’s sweet, playful, curious, and absolutely irresistible.

Éclair is just as delightful as her name suggests. She may be small, but Éclair has plenty of love to give. If you’re looking for a beautiful little shadow to brighten up your days, Éclair might just be the sweetest addition to your family.
